name: Earth Island Institute
summary: US charity that takes environmental projects of any size into its own network for the long term, with application rounds through the year.

evidence.quote: Earth Island's project support program is at the heart of our mission to conserve, preserve, and restore the environment.
we have become a social impact platform for community groups and activist leaders who are responding to today's urgent environmental issues
Our fiscal sponsorship has grown to cover a wide range of environmental issues, campaigns, strategies, and regions.
Nonprofit 501(c)(3) status through Earth Island enables your project to receive tax-exempt donations from individuals and foundations.

steps.value: Read the instructions and fill in the templates and budget worksheet

evidence.quote: download the application instructions and templates along with the budget worksheet

steps.value: Apply by one of four deadlines a year

evidence.quote: We consider new projects four times a year, and application deadlines are December 1, March 1, June 30, and October 1.

steps.value: Review, board decision and orientation; 3 to 4 months in all

evidence.quote: In general, it takes between three and four months for a project to submit a project application, go through the review process, get adopted by the Board of Directors, and complete orientation.
